description: On a link negotiated Short a DATA-ONLY of the 16-bit family (type 9) is not used and draws WARNING reason 3, since the two families are never mixed on one link.
note: Link setup as cas/short-family-negotiated: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with Short and Ed4 set, our accept with Short and Ed4 goes out at 52000, and when it ends at 57550 the link is made with the 8-bit family (B-0141, B-0232) and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). Conn 1 has bound SAP 9 for ARQ. At 61000 the peer sends a DATA-ONLY of the 16-bit family (type 9, FSN 0, 'ping'). The families are never mixed on one link (C-0762, C-0763), so on this link a type 9 is a recognised D_PDU that is not allowed: it is not processed, nothing is delivered or acknowledged, cas.first_data keeps running, and a WARNING with RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 9 and reason 3 is queued (C-0391, C-0382, interp C-1192), the CAS being told D_WARNING_TRANSMITTED (C-0733), which has no output. The burst ends at 62000: csma.vdcd_end to 71000, LBT rule 1, contention 12000 ms. At 83000 the WARNING goes: 12 bytes, EOT 10. The peer is recorded Ed4, so the 13 spare bytes of the block take one PADDING D_PDU (C-0367, C-1154). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so a one-block transmission lasts 5550 ms, EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133): a WARNING is 12 bytes, a PADDING D_PDU 11. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4: contention waits 45000, 12000 ms (K-0080).  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
